narrative.overview: A structural arch and broad geometric cradle protect a central amber identity. The chosen emblem sits directly beside lowercase identity in the family signature: official firefly, divider, protection emblem and identity. Technical slugs remain firefly-id.

rules.name: Meaning before abstraction
rules.body: Protected identity must remain understandable and legible at 16–24 px.

rules.name: One family voice
rules.body: Use the exact canonical palette and Manrope across brand, layouts and forms.

donts: Do not replace meaning with an unexplained abstract motif.
Do not add generic experience slogans to the repository banner.
Do not infer trademark grants from software licensing.
